Our Vision

To be a leading Nursing Agency nationally, through the provision of highly professional and dedicated staff.


Our Mission

We strive to fulfill our vision by attracting and retaining highly skilled and dedicated nursing staff.


Our Values

Honesty & integrity; Pride & dignity; Accountability & reliability; Excellence; Exceeding your expectations.

What We Do


Seanda Healthcare is the Health Professional Placement Agency. Our core business focus is to ensure that we supply Health Professionals of the highest caliber to our Clients. Our Company has been in existence since year 2000 and has enjoyed a steady growth over the years. We have already established a healthy footprint in 7 Provinces in South Africa and we are currently expanding our business to the rest of the Country.
